text.en: Expecting G(x, ξ) to be one smooth formula valid everywhere — missing that it is genuinely piecewise, with a different expression for x < ξ than for x > ξ, matched at x = ξ by continuity in G itself but a jump in its derivative (the signature of the point impulse sitting exactly there).
text.et: Ootamine, et G(x, ξ) on üks sujuv valem, mis kehtib kõikjal — jättes tähele panemata, et see on tegelikult tükiti määratud, teistsuguse avaldisega x < ξ ja x > ξ korral, mis on kohal x = ξ ühendatud G enda pidevusega, kuid tuletise hüppega (just see on punktimpulsi tunnusmärk selles kohas).
